snippet.title: Elixir of Moonglow Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.
